summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AAM Transformers ETF (TRFM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Pence Transformers index. The fund tracks a modified equal-weighted index of US-listed companies that have the potential to transform consumer behavior and technological innovation. Companies are screened for their spending on research and development (R&D). TRFM was launched on Jul 11, 2022 and is issued by Advisors Asset Management.

holdings.infoBox: TRFM is an equity ETF with a total of 272 individual holdings. The top holdings are Advanced Micro Devices stock at 0.94%, Intel at 0.89%, CrowdStrike Holdings at 0.85%, Datadog at 0.84%, and Cloudflare at 0.84%.
